notes.title: Update on Virtual Rogue
notes.notes:
I first want to thank everyone who has enjoyed playing Virtual Rogue over the years. I know we enjoyed developing it!

However, we have decided that we are going to retire Virtual Rogue from Steam. This means that it will no longer be possible to buy new copies of Virtual Rogue. If you've already bought it then you should still have access to it.

The game will be officially retired on November 12 around 1 PM PST.

Thanks again to everyone who played!
